name: EH3D-SUITE-LAUNCHER
notes: Functional v0.0.6: a library and a command line that find the programs of the suite by their eh3d.project.json manifests, start a program and start it again a limited number of times when it fails, keep the list of recent projects and read and write the project file (.eh3dproj: name, files with kind and SHA-256, work zero). A window (egui, built with the gui feature: the recent projects, open or create a project, add and remove its files, the programs of the suite with a button to start each one) is written and its logic is tested, but it has not been built or looked at on a screen. No discovery of machines on the network, and nothing here has run on a machine.
